scope: Dynamic attribute grouping in the admin: attribute_set_items.group_key drives labeled fieldset groups in the admin product-model edit (Processor/RAM/Storage/GPU/Power) and in the attribute-set manager (per-item group display + add-item group input). Dev-DB junk (legacy 7000-series categories/brands/models, Spec Test fixtures) removed so the admin catalog shows only the genuine 18-category seed.

businessFlow.subject: The admin product-model edit modal renders the Desktop PC attributes in data-driven labeled groups instead of one flat list, and the attribute-set manager shows each item's group and accepts a group when adding an item. The admin catalog lists only the genuine seed categories after junk cleanup.

notes: Grouping comes from attribute_set_items.group_key (seeded per component) and is rendered as labeled fieldsets in the admin — no component name is hardcoded in the UI. The customer web sell flow was reverted to plain model dropdowns per the user's direction; only the admin grouping remains.
